title: Credit Builder Accounts Application, Approval and Activation Standard
content:
## Standard

1. Credit Builder has no minimum credit score; an applicant must meet the minimum age, the plan's minimum monthly income and identity verification, and must pay from a linked checking account of their own. The payment account is a linked checking account of the applicant whose verification status is verified.
2. An applicant with a Larkspur personal loan, PracticePay plan or FlexLine in charged-off status is declined.
3. The account activates the plan's activation period (1 business day on every Credit Builder Accounts plan) after approval, once the administration fee is debited: the loan amount is advanced and deposited into the locked savings certificate on the same day, the first due date is the first due day at least 25 calendar days after activation, and the maturity date is the due date the plan's term of monthly payments later.
4. Activation lines (the loan advance, the certificate funding and the administration fee) are written only for an account in active status.
5. An application not completed within the plan's application validity period (30 calendar days) lapses as cancelled, and the applicant may cancel before activation at no cost; once active, the administration fee is not refundable.

The verified checking account, and any charged-off Larkspur personal loan, PracticePay plan or FlexLine, are established from the system's records of the applicant, not from the applicant's own statement. The checking account looked at is the one named on this application.

## Account states

An application starts in applied status. It becomes active when it is approved, the administration fee is paid and the loan amount is deposited into the certificate; it becomes cancelled when the applicant cancels before activation or when it lapses.

## First due date (hypothetical activation dates)

| Activation date | Due day | Candidate due date | Calendar days after activation | First due date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 28 | 28 March | 27 | 28 March |
| 1 March | 20 | 20 March | 19, fewer than 25 | 20 April |
| 1 March | 26 | 26 March | 25 | 26 March |

## Decline and decision points

| Applicant's records | Judgement |
|---|---|
| a Larkspur personal loan in charged-off status | declined |
| a PracticePay plan in charged-off status | declined |
| a FlexLine in charged-off status | declined |
| payment account a checking account of the applicant, verification status verified | payment account requirement met |
| payment account not verified | payment account requirement not met |
